mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital toward equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 100,000 jobs per month strengthens consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,500,000 units signal weak consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as housing sector weakness reduces GDP contribution.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate rises indicate stagflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as inflation and stagnation jointly depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE increases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions reduce corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
